positions.name: RatifiedAsyncContractMechanics
positions.frame: How does a ratified async job contract settle the operational mechanics of dispatch, retrieval, and loss-prevention?
positions.why: Both expressions perform the async job contract as a ratified, load-bearing operational rule stated in present-realis as settled fact. src-1 is Wynn's witness-depth ratification naming the contract's terms — receipt return, polling cursor, no blocking, no lost work — while src-2 compresses the same decision into its dispatch-and-retrieval summary. They share technical register, informational authority via ratification, and decision-grade conviction: the same directional read of a contract being specified as operational mechanics holds both.
